bindings.qualification: Release subset contains only native rows explicitly labeled brenda, using each retained row's value/log10_value. All pooled max/mean target columns, sabio rows and ambiguous uniprot_search origins are excluded. This changes the prediction target from CatPred's aggregate benchmark to a retained BRENDA-record response. Source preprocessing capped extreme values; no claim of uncensored raw laboratory measurements. Intended source units retained, no independent experimental unit audit. Derived 40%-cluster split is not the original random split. Native combined source assets must not be redistributed as part of this cleared subset.
bindings.reference_evidence: Identifiable BRENDA retained record, established by pinned source-specific processors and merge.py; mathematical log10/value consistency checked.
